entities.summary: Spring of Nations & 'United Slovenia', a transformative movement in Slovenia (1848–1914). Emerged from Napoleonic Illyrian Provinces and Napoleon establishes the Illyrian Provinces with capital at Ljubljana. Catalyzed WWI – Isonzo Front.
